citation: MESSpy contributors. Multi-Energy System Simulator. https://github.com/pielube/MESSpy
description: MESSpy is the University of Florence's simulator for renewable energy communities, individual buildings and hydrogen-integrated systems. It contains models of generation, storage, heat equipment and hydrogen or ammonia technologies. Inputs combine CSV load profiles with JSON system configurations and economic assumptions; outputs include energy balances, cash flows and net present values in CSV or pickle files. The documented timestep ranges from one to 60 minutes, with horizons of one or more years. Geographic coverage follows the configured community or facility. Python source is free under EUPL-1.2-or-later. A limitation is that technology detail remains under development and observed demand profiles may be unavailable, requiring separately generated inputs. The model supports local energy-infrastructure planning and electrification studies. PyPSA (model-pypsa) is a related system modeller. Its demonstration scenarios do not establish performance for an actual community.
inputs: JSON technology, system and economic parameters
